description: Market trials on new launches: every trading rule switched on and off against a coin flip (preregistered before its trades existed, signed once they played out), newest first, on every chain the lab follows (Solana, Base, BNB Chain, Ethereum, Robinhood Chain, Elysium and more) or on Elysium read block by block; what the last day's launches did in their first hour, chain by chain; and the rules OPSIN designs itself, one change at a time, each measured on new launches against the rule it came from.
name: opsin_markets
